title: Above Food Strengthens its Pet Food Ingredient Platform with Recent Montana-Based Asset Acquisition
description: Above Food Ingredients Inc. has acquired the specialty crop food ingredient division of The Redwood Group, LLC, significantly enhancing its presence in the rapidly growing plant-based pet food market. The acquisition expands Above Food's pet food business to approximately US$110M of combined company revenues on a proforma basis, positioning the company to capitalize on the US$26 billion global plant-based pet food market.

title: Oats Market Projected Value at USD 10.97 Billion by 2033 | Healthy CAGR of 5.5%
description: The global oats market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 5.5% from 2024 to 2033, driven by increasing consumer awareness of the health benefits of oats and the rising popularity of plant-based diets. The market is expected to reach an estimated USD 10.97 billion by 2033.
